# Choros

> We build the software and AI systems established UK businesses run on. Platforms delivered in months, not years. See our work.

## Services
- [AI Implementation](https://choros.io/ai-implementation/): We audit where AI genuinely removes cost from your business, then build what the numbers justify. Fixed-price audit, two weeks.
- [Software Development](https://choros.io/software-development/): Custom platforms and internal tools for UK businesses. Fixed scope, fixed price, you own the code.
- [Marketing](https://choros.io/marketing/): Google Ads, Meta Ads, local SEO and the automation behind them, for showrooms, trades and hospitality across the UK.

## Marketing sectors
- [Home Services & Trades](https://choros.io/marketing/home-services-trades/): Google Ads, local SEO, review systems and instant lead follow-up for home services and trade businesses across the UK. Jobs booked, not clicks counted.
- [Kitchen & Bathroom Showrooms](https://choros.io/marketing/kitchen-bathroom-showrooms/): Google Ads, Meta Ads, local SEO and automated follow-up that turn local searches into booked design consultations. For kitchen and bathroom showrooms across the UK.
- [Restaurants & Hospitality](https://choros.io/marketing/restaurants-hospitality/): Covers on quiet nights, bookings instead of likes. Google, Meta, local SEO and automated follow-up for restaurants and hospitality businesses across the UK.

## Work
- [Work](https://choros.io/work/): Software and AI projects we built and still run, including a treasury platform quoted at £1M and delivered for a tenth of that.
- [HedgePoint](https://choros.io/work/hedgepoint/): A £1M development quote for an FX treasury platform, delivered for a tenth of that in four months — with more features than the original scope. Built and still run by Choros.
- [Curveball](https://choros.io/work/curveball/): Three full-time staff were repricing against Amazon, eBay and CeX by hand. Choros automated it in three weeks and all three went back to distribution.
- [Altitude 28](https://choros.io/work/altitude-28/): Stock was going missing and nobody could say where. Choros installed AI vision cameras tied into stock management, so the answer stopped being a guess.

## Products
- [Solutions](https://choros.io/solutions/): Software products built and run by Choros, including our instant website builder.
- [Instant Website Builder](https://choros.io/solutions/instant-website-builder/): An AI website builder for small businesses, coaches and creators. Copy, images, layout and SEO generated automatically. Free plan available.
